general.title: General Settings

general.transcription.originalTarget.des: Choose where completed dictations go if you switch applications while Voice Flow is processing.
general.transcription.originalTarget.ena: Remember the application and editable field focused when recording starts.
general.transcription.originalTarget.for: More reliable. The original application comes to the foreground before Voice Flow inserts the text.
general.transcription.originalTarget.bac: Does not interrupt your current application, but can fail in games and fields without writable Accessibility support.
general.startup.title: Startup
general.startup.autoStartDesc: Automatically launch Voice Flow when you log in to your computer
general.startup.recordingSoundDesc: Play a soft tone when recording starts or stops
general.startup.stayInTrayDesc: Show an extra system tray icon. Closing the main window hides it without quitting.
general.audio.title: Audio Input
general.audio.description: Select the microphone to use for recording
general.audio.processingDesc: Configure noise reduction and silence trimming to optimize recognition speed and quality.
general.audio.vadDesc: Automatically trim silence at the start/end and collapse long pauses to speed up transcription. Turn off if you speak very quietly.
general.audio.contextAwareDesc: Use focused-window context at recording start to help STT and polish models understand what you mean.

general.display.pillBackgroundOpacityDes: Adjust the pill background transparency while keeping controls visible

general.language.description: Choose the display language for Voice Flow

general.privacy.title: Privacy
general.privacy.textRetentionDesc: Choose how long transcription text stays on this device. Selecting Never deletes existing text history immediately.
general.privacy.audioRetentionDesc: Choose how long captured WAV files stay on this device. Successful audio is deleted by default.
general.privacy.retentionStatus: Stored locally: {{textEntries}} text entries and {{audioFiles}} audio files ({{audioSize}}).
general.privacy.retentionApplyError: The setting was saved, but some local files could not be deleted. Voice Flow will retry automatically.
general.privacy.analyticsDesc: Join our improvement program to help us optimize the experience. Only crash reports and usage statistics are collected—no voice or text content is recorded.
general.privacy.correctionMemoryDesc: Remember short word or phrase replacements only. Punctuation, sentence splitting, and formatting edits are ignored.
general.privacy.correctionMemoryClearDes: Remove all locally remembered word correction pairs from this device.
general.privacy.correctionMemoryClearErr: Failed to clear Word Correction Memory
general.privacy.correctionMemoryOpenDesc: Open the folder that contains the word correction JSON file.

model.polish.templateFillerDesc: Clean raw speech into natural writing. Removes fillers, repetition, self-corrections, and obvious STT mistakes without changing meaning.
model.polish.templateChatDesc: Turn speech into a clear, natural message for chat apps. Keeps it concise without making it overly formal.
model.polish.templateFormalDesc: Polish speech into email or workplace writing with clear, courteous, complete sentences.
model.polish.templateConciseDesc: Shorten and simplify text while preserving key facts, names, dates, numbers, constraints, and requests.
model.polish.templateDocumentDesc: Organize longer dictation into readable notes or document prose with paragraphs, section labels, or lists.
model.polish.templateAgentDesc: Format rough spoken requirements as a clear Markdown prompt for AI agents while preserving constraints and acceptance criteria.
model.polish.templatePromptPlaceholder: Enter the instructions for the polish model...
model.polish.templateDeleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete the template "{{name}}"?
model.polish.templateCustomDesc: Write your own custom prompt to define how the text should be processed.
model.polish.cloud.enableDesc: Use a cloud-based LLM for text polish instead of local models. Requires API key.
model.polish.cloud.enableThinkingDesc: Enable thinking mode for supported models (e.g., Qwen with Coding Plan). May increase response time.

model.polish.compat.memoryUnknown: Device memory could not be detected. {{recommendedMemory}} RAM is recommended for smooth local polish.
